title: Toward equipping Artificial Moral Agents with multiple ethical theories
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating a multi-layered model (Genet) to represent and instantiate various normative ethical theories, including Utilitarianism, Egoism, Kantianism, and Divine Command Theory (specifically a Christian version), for use in Artificial Moral Agents. It evaluates these models using moral dilemma use cases such as the trolley problem.
